## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a practical multilingual NLP feature with interpretability, labeling strategy, and rollout controls in production.

## Key Concepts

- Hybrid regex + ML approach for hedging
- Multilingual handling and code-switching
- Per-message explanations for explanations
- Lightweight data labeling (active learning)
- Offline evaluation + staged rollout with drift alerts

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudocode: combine regex hits with ML score
const hedges = [/maybe/i, /perhaps/i, /could be/i];
function score(message, model) {
  const r = hedges.some(pat => pat.test(message));
  const m = model.predict(message); // returns 0..1 hedging likelihood
  return { score: Math.max(r ? 0.6 : 0, m) };
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you extend to additional languages with minimal retraining?
- How would you measure false positives in production and adjust thresholds?
